map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Crawford, Franklin, Hamilton, Hancock, Henry, Morrow and Trumbull publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-31 03:00): mail returned 13,553 (state 13,277); early in person 38,833 (state 34,662). Clermont (as of 2026-10-31 10:37): mail returned 11,724 (state 11,315); early in person 17,816 (state 15,917). Crawford (as of 2026-10-30 15:41): mail returned 1,886 (state 1,835); early in person 3,317 (state 3,136). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-30 19:48): mail returned 100,574 (state 96,382); early in person 47,769 (state 43,394). Franklin (as of 2026-10-31 00:12): mail returned 66,776 (state 64,258); early in person 84,397 (state 76,759). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-30 20:09): early in person 69,238 (state 61,614); ballots returned, any method 107,184 (state 98,538). Hancock: mail returned 2,604 (state 2,578). Henry (as of 2026-10-27 16:58): early in person 3,194 (state 2,954). Morrow (as of 2026-10-30 16:59): mail returned 1,270 (state 1,233); early in person 3,253 (state 2,997). Trumbull (as of 2026-10-31 07:38): mail returned 10,818 (state 10,587); early in person 16,402 (state 15,202).
